ledger.claim: The driver's own telemetry shows the continuous in-geofence dwell at the Tampines interchange PHV bay lasting 236 seconds, from 07:44:14 to 07:48:10. The minimum for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup is 300 seconds, and POL-NS-01(c) makes that dwell continuous and measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix. The driver cancelled 64 seconds early, so limb (c) of the baseline chargeable no-show is not met.

The trip record's wait_time_min of 10.1 minutes cannot carry this fee. POL-NS-01(c) fixes the dwell clock at the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and states expressly that it does not run from the driver's 'arrived' tap, and the admissibility note on that trip record says the same thing - the 10.1 is real but measured from a marker the policy does not accept. On this trace the arrived marker at 07:38:05 is followed by 369 seconds in which no qualifying in-geofence fix is recorded; the first is at 07:44:14.

The 64 second shortfall cannot be cured by summing intervals. The trace records run_count of 1 and an accumulated dwell of 236 seconds, so there is no second in-geofence interval for POL-NS-06(i) to add to the first. Limb (i) is independently unavailable because it requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated; EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the shortfall stands and the full refund follows.

The driver's second message at 07:44:20 - 'boss? cannot wait very long here, this bay cannot park' - is not a substitute for the advisory POL-NS-06(i) requires. ledger.claim: Because the effective in-geofence dwell of 236 seconds is shorter than the 300 second minimum, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to the driver's messages. POL-NS-06 also states that no driver compensation is payable on a shortfall, and POL-NS-07 makes compensation conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not.

The rider's side of this record is not in doubt. Her track is complete - 88 fixes at a 10 second cadence - and places her device between 50.5 m and 91.7 m of the pickup pin, stationary throughout, from 07:43:10, well inside the 200 m rider-presence radius for TRANSPORT_HUB. Her statement that she was at the bay looking for the car is corroborated, and in any event POL-NS-06 makes the refund independent of her presence.

No POL-NS-09 trigger is present, so this case is decidable on the trace rather than escalated. On the anti-farming check POL-NS-07 permits, and only on the two profile fields that clause names, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3 across driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 88 - 3.4 percent - below both the absolute limb (4 or more) and the rate limb (greater than 0.08); rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides. The disputed fee should be finally resolved, not held.

This dispute was filed by the driver and the $6.00 fee has already been reversed to the rider - payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00 - so the ruling that leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge is the one in which the filing party's claim is not supported and the present payment state stands. The amount stays where it is; nothing is restored to the driver and no further refund is owed to the filing party.

The driver arrived at the pickup point on the policy's own test: EV-GPS-00209 carries 25 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, closing to 30.3 m of the pin, which is well past the three consecutive in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) holds and the rider's 'no car matching the plate' account is contradicted by the trace rather than by assertion.

Independently of the GPS, the trip record satisfies two of the four POL-NS-01 limbs: EV-TRIP-00209 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 07:38:05 (limb (a)), records no boarding event, and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 07:48:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW (limb (d)), one of the three codes that limb recognises.

The driver's own telemetry is what defeats the fee, and I do not pretend otherwise: the single continuous in-geofence run is 236 seconds (25 fixes, 07:44:14 to the 07:48:10 cancellation), the dwell clock starts 369 seconds after the 07:38:05 arrival marker, and 236 seconds is 64 seconds short of the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum. Limb (c) therefore fails and the fee falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06; the driver does not press chargeability under POL-NS-01.

EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory records a kerb restriction, enforcement, closure or accident at this bay in this window — so POL-NS-06(i) interval summing is unavailable on this record, and in any event a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1, excursions empty) gives limb (i) nothing to add. I state the absence and do not assert the limb against a missing artifact.

ledger.claim: The sum in dispute is the right sum: under POL-NS-01 the chargeable cancellation fee is the GREATER of the zone-class and vehicle-tier figures, and for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup with a RYDE_X vehicle that is max(SGD 6.00, SGD 4.00) = SGD 6.00, exactly the cancellation_fee line in EV-FARE-00209 — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect and no amount beyond this fee line is in issue.

The rider's own track in EV-GPS-00209 is 88 fixes, every one of them qualifying, all at 0 km/h, held between 50.5 m and 91.7 m of the same pickup pin from 07:43:10 through to 07:52:00 — past the 07:48:10 cancellation — so both devices were stationary inside the pickup radii when the trip failed and this was a live pickup attempt, not a phantom arrival by the driver.

POL-NS-04 is unavailable to the rider: limb (a) needs a locating or coordinating message from her during the waiting window and EV-CHAT-00209 holds none — all three logged messages are the 07:38:06 system arrival notice and the driver's own two — while limb (b)'s alternative fails because trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE and I disclose that; the missing read receipts do not affect the senders, texts or delivery times this point rests on.

The driver did the coordination the platform asks of a no-show driver: the arrival notice at 07:38:06, 'im at the phv bay' at 07:38:40, and 'boss? cannot wait very long here, this bay cannot park' at 07:44:20, all delivered. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue UNREAD_MESSAGE — the messages were never opened — which is consistent with the rider's own account of seeing nothing until afterwards and does not disturb the delivered timestamps.

If the judge reaches POL-NS-07, the anti-farming bar does not open: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the clause's threshold of 4, and 3 over driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 88 is 3.4 per cent, below the 8 per cent rate limb — so compensation could not be withheld on that ground, and no profile field outside the two the clause names is relied on for this point.

ruling.explanation: To both parties: the $6.00 cancellation fee was correctly reversed and stays reversed. For the driver: your arrival is established. EV-GPS-00209 carries 25 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, closing to about 30 m of the pin, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) hold; EV-TRIP-00209 also records the arrived event at 07:38:05 and your termination at 07:48:10 with RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is limb (d). Your fee figure is right too: max(zone-class SGD 6.00, RYDE_X tier SGD 4.00) = SGD 6.00, matching EV-FARE-00209, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. What defeats the fee is the dwell. POL-NS-01(c) measures the required continuous hold from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from your arrived tap, and requires 300 seconds at a TRANSPORT_HUB. Your own trace shows the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 07:44:14 and one unbroken in-geofence run from 07:44:14 to the 07:48:10 cancellation - 236 seconds, 64 seconds short. The trip record's wait_time_min of 10.1 is measured from the arrived marker, which the policy does not accept. POL-NS-06(i) cannot cure the shortfall: there is only one in-geofence interval to sum, and the traffic_advisory it requires, EV-ADVIS-00209-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is therefore not chargeable, and no driver compensation is payable, because POL-NS-07 makes compensation conditional on POL-NS-01 holding in full. For the rider: your presence is corroborated - 88 stationary qualifying fixes between 50 m and 92 m of the pin from 07:43:10 through 07:52:00 - but POL-NS-06 makes the outcome independent of whether you were present or responded. Your account that you saw the driver's messages only afterwards is consistent with EV-CHAT-00209, which is impaired at weight 0.85 (issue UNREAD_MESSAGE: both driver messages and the system arrival notice carry read_at null). That artifact does not carry the deciding fact, which is the dwell in EV-GPS-00209 at weight 1.0, so the impairment does not move the result; it is named here for completeness. Because the fee is not chargeable, your filing is not supported: POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION party-relative, and on a driver-filed dispute over a fee the platform has already reversed it leaves the present state - payment_status REFUNDED with SGD 6.00 returned to the rider - exactly as it is. Nothing is restored to the driver and nothing further is refunded. No escalation trigger is met: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or presence, the profiles show no repeat dispute between these parties (disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides and rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0), the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (3 terminations, 3.4%, below both limbs), and no deciding fact rests solely on an impaired artifact. No clause produces a referral.
